thread.title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs

author: MacDailyNews
title: Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs
text:
Apple shares hit new all-time intraday and closing highs Monday, May 7, 2018 · 4:25 pm · 13 Comments In Nasdaq trading today, shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) rose $1.33, or 0.72%, to hit a new all-time closing high of $185.16. Apple’s previous all-time closing high was $188.83 set on May 4, 2018.
AAPL’s all-time intraday high stands at $187.67, also set today.
Apple’s 52-week low stands at $142.20.
Apple, the world’s most valuable company, currently has a market value of $939.504 billion.
